mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY FACSTOP.FSTP_CODE) AS ROW_NUM, FACILITY.FAC_NAME, FACSTOP.FSTP_PLAN, FACSTOP.FSTP_TU, FACSTOP.FSTP_STBY, FACSTOP.FSTP_01, FACSTOP.FSTP_02, FACSTOP.FSTP_03, FACSTOP.FSTP_04, FACSTOP.FSTP_05, FACSTOP.FSTP_06, FACSTOP.FSTP_07, FACSTOP.FSTP_08, FACSTOP.FSTP_09, FACSTOP.FSTP_10, FSTP_BIGO, FSTP_CODE, LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR, FACSTOP.FSTP_DATE, 120), 10) AS FSTP_DATE FROM FACSTOP INNER JOIN FACILITY ON FACSTOP.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE WHERE FACSTOP.FSTP_DATE between #{sdate} and #{edate} ORDER BY FACSTOP.FSTP_DATE, FACILITY.FAC_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FACSTOP ( FSTP_CODE, FAC_CODE, FSTP_DATE, FSTP_PLAN, FSTP_TU, FSTP_STBY, FSTP_SIL, FSTP_MAN, FSTP_MHR, FSTP_01, FSTP_02, FSTP_03, FSTP_04, FSTP_05, FSTP_06, FSTP_07, FSTP_08, FSTP_09, FSTP_10, FSTP_BIGO ) VALUES ( (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(FSTP_CODE), 0) + 1 FROM FACSTOP), #{fac_code}, #{fstp_date}, #{fstp_plan}, #{fstp_tu}, #{fstp_stby}, #{fstp_sil}, #{fstp_man}, #{fstp_mhr} , #{fstp_01}, #{fstp_02}, #{fstp_03}, #{fstp_04}, #{fstp_05}, #{fstp_06}, #{fstp_07}, #{fstp_08}, #{fstp_09}, #{fstp_10}, #{fstp_bigo} )
mapper.select: SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000; SELECT FACSTOP.FSTP_CODE, FACSTOP.FAC_CODE, LEFT(CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(datetime, FACSTOP.FSTP_DATE, 120), 120), 10) AS FSTP_DATE, FACSTOP.FSTP_PLAN, FACSTOP.FSTP_TU, FACSTOP.FSTP_STBY, FACSTOP.FSTP_SIL, FACSTOP.FSTP_MAN, FACSTOP.FSTP_MHR, FACSTOP.FSTP_01, FACSTOP.FSTP_02, FACSTOP.FSTP_03, FACSTOP.FSTP_04, FACSTOP.FSTP_05, FACSTOP.FSTP_06, FACSTOP.FSTP_07, FACSTOP.FSTP_08, FACSTOP.FSTP_09, FACSTOP.FSTP_10, FACSTOP.FSTP_BIGO, FACILITY.FAC_NAME FROM FACSTOP WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN FACILITY WITH(NOLOCK) ON FACSTOP.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE where FSTP_CODE = #{fstp_code}
mapper.update: UPDATE FACSTOP SET FAC_CODE = #{fac_code}, FSTP_DATE = #{fstp_date}, FSTP_PLAN = #{fstp_plan}, FSTP_TU = #{fstp_tu}, FSTP_STBY = #{fstp_stby}, FSTP_SIL = #{fstp_sil}, FSTP_MAN = #{fstp_man}, FSTP_MHR = #{fstp_mhr}, FSTP_01 = #{fstp_01}, FSTP_02 = #{fstp_02}, FSTP_03 = #{fstp_03}, FSTP_04 = #{fstp_04}, FSTP_05 = #{fstp_05}, FSTP_06 = #{fstp_06}, FSTP_07 = #{fstp_07}, FSTP_08 = #{fstp_08}, FSTP_09 = #{fstp_09}, FSTP_10 = #{fstp_10}, FSTP_BIGO = #{fstp_bigo} WHERE FSTP_CODE = #{fstp_code}
mapper.select: SET LOCK_TIMEOUT 10000; SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.fac_code) AS ROW_NUM, t.fac_code, t.fac_name, t.gubn, t.total_time, t.run_time, t.idle_registered, CASE WHEN t.total_time - t.run_time < 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_time - t.run_time END AS idle_natural, (CASE WHEN t.total_time - t.run_time < 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_time - t.run_time END) + t.idle_registered AS idle_total, ROUND(t.run_time * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_time, 0), 2) AS RunRate, ROUND(((CASE WHEN t.total_time - t.run_time < 0 THEN 0 ELSE t.total_time - t.run_time END) + t.idle_registered) * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_time, 0), 2) AS idle_rate FROM ( SELECT FAC.FAC_CODE AS fac_code, FAC.FAC_NAME AS fac_name, CASE WHEN FAC.FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18) THEN '열처리' ELSE '템퍼링' END AS gubn, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, #{sdate}, DATEADD(DAY, 1, #{edate})) AS total_time, ISNULL(WI.run_time, 0) AS run_time, ISNULL(FS.idle_registered, 0) AS idle_registered FROM FACILITY FAC LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FAC_CODE, SUM( CASE WHEN ILBO_END IS NULL OR ILBO_END = '1900-01-01 00:00' OR ILBO_END <= ILBO_STRT THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(MINUTE, ILBO_STRT, ILBO_END) END ) AS run_time FROM WORKILBO WHERE FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18,16,17) AND ILBO_STRT BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} GROUP BY FAC_CODE ) WI ON WI.FAC_CODE = FAC.FAC_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FAC_CODE, SUM(ISNULL(TRY_CONVERT(INT, FSTP_10), 0)) AS idle_registered FROM FACSTOP WHERE FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18,16,17) AND FSTP_DATE BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} GROUP BY FAC_CODE ) FS ON FS.FAC_CODE = FAC.FAC_CODE WHERE FAC.FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18,16,17) ) t ORDER BY t.fac_code

SELECT FACILITY.FAC_NAME AS fac_name, COUNT(*) AS work_cnt, SUM(WORKILBO.ILBO_JUNG) AS work_jung, MIN(WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT) AS work_strt, MAX(CASE WHEN WORKILBO.ILBO_END = '1900-01-01 00:00' THEN NULL ELSE WORKILBO.ILBO_END END) AS work_end, SUM( CASE WHEN WORKILBO.ILBO_END IS NULL OR WORKILBO.ILBO_END = '1900-01-01 00:00' OR WORKILBO.ILBO_END <= WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(MINUTE, WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT, WORKILBO.ILBO_END) END ) AS work_time FROM WORKILBO INNER JOIN FACILITY ON FACILITY.FAC_CODE = WORKILBO.FAC_CODE WHERE WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT BETWEEN #{sdate} AND #{edate} AND FACILITY.FAC_CODE IN (1,2,3,4,18,16,17) GROUP BY FACILITY.FAC_NAME ORDER BY FACILITY.FAC_NAME
